messages.subject: Constraining a1 = -a2
parts:
If I am modeling a 2-factor model with 10 indicators (items) per factor and 1 indicator (item) loading on both factors, is it possible to constrain the slope parameter a1 of that item to equal the negative of the slope parameter a2 of that item?
Thanks,
Berend
